title: HandLive — relay routing wrapper (WS text frame on /v1/relay)
description: 00-common-specs 0.4.3, CONN-03 API 6: the device sends {to, env}; the relay turns it into {from, env} for the destination. env is the intact 0.5.1 envelope; the relay never decrypts it. Binary frames use the HR frame instead (test-vectors/relay-frame.json).

to.description: device_id of the destination: the peer in a valid pair with the sender.

from.description: device_id of the sender, taken from its JWT.
